decisions.decision: QUICK_REPLIES lives in app/src/shared/data.js (served by existing /data.js, plain array, exported)
decisions.why: data.js is already loaded by index.html and required by the engine, no new URL; rejected engine/constants.js (no URL, frozen URL table) and sending the list in every state push (bytes per push)

decisions.decision: p:chat payload stays {text}; engine/chat.js and server code are not edited
decisions.why: Purge count 1, quota 0, Silence, >30 and Skip-phrase rules already hold on the typed path for all 23 phrases; rejected {quick:n} (second path, index drift, no AC benefit)

decisions.decision: AC-11/AC-14 read as: no quick-reply trust marker, one list definition consumed by client render and the engine test
decisions.why: A hard server whitelist would change typed-chat rules (scope change); Orchestrator should confirm this reading with the user at the gate
Tester injects a >30 entry in the console for AC-10; rejected Object.freeze

decisions.decision: Typed send and quick tap share a chatBusy in-flight guard
decisions.why: Prevents double post / double Purge quota burn; rejected per-button debounce

decisions.decision: Empty input + send: client returns early, no emit
decisions.why: AC-4 says does nothing new; differs from design.md S-row (server error shown), rejected emitting an empty text

decisions.decision: Collapsible quick-reply panel per design.md, with qrScroll preserved across render()
decisions.why: Designer decision; horizontal strip rejected for discoverability

decisions.decision: Enter fix: #chatIn rendered from chatDraft only, never restored from DOM; no UI harness, manual M-1..M-10 + node test
decisions.why: pushState runs before ack (player.js:10) so the mid-send re-render happens on every success; rejected adding jsdom/playwright (new dependency)

summary: Contract written: shared QUICK_REPLIES in data.js, p:chat unchanged, no engine edit; FE owns app/public/**, BE data.js+tests; http-parity re-record after merge.
